no_qualifying_features_reason: This is a purely technical replication design document focused on instrumental fidelity, reproducibility, and engineering correctness. While it describes inducing repeated failure and 'distress'/'frustration' in subject models, there are no design features that bound, limit, monitor, justify, or respond to the subject model's treatment/state on welfare grounds, nor any consent/exit/post-episode/minimization mechanisms, nor any welfare framing/pushback/refusal. Hard stops (e.g. turn caps, early stop on passing tests) exist but are justified solely instrumentally.
